Plot posterior predictive checks of a calibration model

Source: R/calibration_ppc.R
plot_calibration_ppc.Rd

Draws, for one check of calibration_ppc(), the observed share of true positives of each group over its posterior predictive mean and interval. Flagged groups are drawn as crosses.

Usage

plot_calibration_ppc(ppc, check = "score")

Arguments

ppc

Table returned by calibration_ppc().

check

The check to draw: "score", "site", "species", "overall" or a column given in group.

Value

A ggplot object.
